model.name: diagram.renderEdges
model.description: R32.6: relationship EDGES on the R32.4 diagram surface (closes the edges deferred from R32.3/R32.4). DiagramViewModel.buildEdges (the chain anchor) reads each on-diagram box's model relatesTo and draws an edge X->Y IFF Y is ALSO a box on the diagram (off-diagram target = no dangling edge), with the arrowhead by M2 kind (UmlGeneralization hollow-triangle / UmlAssociation open / UmlDependency dashed), de-duped by (from,to,kind). The edges render as an ADDITIVE second SVG pass in rb-diagram-detail in the SAME svg group as the R32.4 boxes (RbPanZoom transforms edges WITH nodes - reuse, no fork); edge-click -> selectionModel.select -> shared drawer relationship detail. buildEdges is a NEW named decl in the same diagram-view-model.ts module as buildDiagramSvg (R32.4 Impl ba96a744) but DISTINCT - it is NOT re-credited (same anchor discipline as R32.5-isModelUnit vs R32.2-generate). Units untouched (R25.7). The R32.6 Test (tester independent vitest r32.6-diagram-edges + gate on the R32.5 demo diagram faa4acad) asserts the 8 finalized ACs incl the R32.4/shared no-regression.
